title: Select the intended SDK when executing a tool
goal: Choose repository-pinned SDK execution with dotnet dnx or deliberate newest-installed-SDK execution through a serviced wrapper, keeping the tool package and runtime requirements separate.

selectionNotes: Serviced SDK 10.0.302/10.0.400 and .NET 11 Preview 6 introduce wrapper bypass; actual serviced 10.0.402 and RC2 wrappers were executed.
SDK 9 is a negative command-availability case only; no extra historical foundation or target-10 catalogue edition.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Required by the net11 checker package; the SDK that executes dnx and a net10 tool runtime are separate decisions.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Target-11 example build; wrapper bypass is also serviced into SDK 10.0.302/10.0.400, with 10.0.402 execution evidence.

language.name: C#
language.reason: C# 15 checker sample mode; SDK selection itself is language independent.

packageAssets: Original local Gullhaven.Museum.Catalogue/1.0.0 tool assets: tools/net10.0/any and tools/net11.0/any in separate packages/feeds.
platforms: Actual Windows x64 dnx.cmd execution; Unix wrapper algorithm source-reviewed only.
prerequisites: Compatible installed SDKs and the tool required runtime; PowerShell 7 for isolated local-feed checks.
Inspect the actual wrapper, working directory and global.json; use separate feeds/caches for the intentionally same-ID comparison packages.
constraints: Explicit dotnet dnx obeys ordinary SDK resolution; a pre-dnx SDK pin fails before tool execution.
Serviced wrappers bypass global.json for SDK selection; package version, tool runtime and SDK selection must be verified independently.
No public package execution/publication, system installation or PATH/persistent environment mutation.
stabilityLimitations: Measured SDK 10.0.402 and 11 RC2; official sources establish the earlier servicing boundary. RC2 is not GA evidence.

evidence.scope: Actual independently compiled net10/net11 checker, no external dependencies; dnx behavior is in the separate execution record.
Real local package execution with SDK 9 negative pin, serviced 10.0.402 and RC2 pins, both shipped wrappers, actual SDK traces/tool runtimes, quoted forwarding and exit 7; Windows x64.
